meta.title: How How Bluetooth Works Works | Tech Explainer
meta.description: Learn how How Bluetooth Works works under the hood through visual motion graphics and first-principles technical breakdown.
facts_to_verify: How Bluetooth Works operates via distributed synchronized state machines.

scenes.title: NO CABLE • SO HOW?
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of NO CABLE • SO HOW?.
scenes.narration: ज़रा सोचिए… आपके फोन में गाना चल रहा है, कानों में इयर-बड्स हैं… लेकिन दोनों के बीच कोई तार नहीं! तो क्या आवाज़ हवा में उड़कर जाती है? आखिर यह जादू होता कैसे है? ---

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
visual.action: 3D smartphone and wireless earbuds floating in studio space. The smartphone screen displays an active music equalizer. A glowing blue physical cable connects phone to earbuds, then dramatically dissolves into vanishing particles over the first 1.5s, leaving the glowing question mark in mid-air.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.
visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.

scenes.title: AUDIO → DIGITAL PACKETS
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of AUDIO → DIGITAL PACKETS.
scenes.narration: असल में, आपका फोन गाने को डि-जि-टल डा-टा के रूप में प्रोसेस करता है। एनालॉग साउंड बाइनरी में बदलकर छोटे-छोटे डा-टा पैकेट्स में पैक हो जाती है! ---

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
visual.action: 3D conceptual cutaway inside the phone. Analog audio waveform ribbon flows into the processing core, shattering into cascading 0 and 1 digital bit cubes that assemble into organized, labeled data packet containers.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.
visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.

scenes.title: RADIO CARRIES DATA
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of RADIO CARRIES DATA.
scenes.narration: फिर फोन का ब्लू-टूथ ट्रांसमीटर इस डा-टा को दो दशमलव चार गीगा-हर्ट्ज़ के रेडियो सिग्नल्स के ज़रिए हवा में ब्रॉडकास्ट करता है। यानी हवा में आवाज़ नहीं, रेडियो वेव्ज़ तैरती हैं! ---

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
objects: Stylized Cutaway Reveals The Phone'S Rf
visual.action: Stylized cutaway reveals the phone's RF module and antenna firing concentric 2.4 GHz electromagnetic wavefront rings. Stream of digital packet cubes rides smoothly along the radio path toward the floating earbuds.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.
visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.

scenes.title: DISCOVER → PAIR → CONNECT
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of DISCOVER → PAIR → CONNECT.
scenes.narration: लेकिन इयर-बड्स को कैसे पता चलता है कि सिग्नल उन्हीं के लिए है? पहली बार दोनों डिवाइसेस पेयरिंग करके सीक्रेट इनक्रिप्शन की एक्सचेंज करते हैं, और एक सुरक्षित कनेक्शन लॉक हो जाता है! ---

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
visual.action: Target earbuds pulse with advertising beacons. Phone identifies the device, initiates pairing exchange, and a glowing 3D security padlock locks in mid-air with a bright green verification ring and active glowing cyan link beam.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.
visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.

scenes.title: RECEIVE + DECODE → AUDIO
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of RECEIVE + DECODE → AUDIO.
scenes.narration: अब असली कमाल देखिए! हवा में तैरते ये पैकेट्स इयर-बड्स के रिसीवर में पहुँचते हैं। डिकोडर चिप इन्हें अनपैक करती है, और स्पीकर का डायफ्राम वाइब्रेट होकर असली म्यूज़िक साउंड वेव्ज़ तैयार करता है! ---

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
objects: Traveling Data Packets Arrive At The Ear
visual.action: Traveling data packets arrive at the earbud receiver module. Internal DAC decoder chip illuminates as packets unpack, and the 3D speaker diaphragm cone visibly vibrates, radiating green acoustic sound waves directly to the ear.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.
visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.

scenes.title: 79 CHANNELS • 1600 HOPS/S
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of 79 CHANNELS • 1600 HOPS/S.
scenes.narration: और वाई-फाई या माइक्रोवेव के इंटरफेरेंस से बचने के लिए, ब्लू-टूथ हर सेकंड सोलह सौ बार अलग-अलग चैनल्स पर छलांग लगाता है—जिसे कहते हैं फ्रीक्वेंसी हॉपिंग! ---

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
visual.action: 3D spectrum of 79 radio channel bars across the 2.4 GHz band. A red Wi-Fi interference curve blocks several channels, and animated neon hopping beams instantly jump across clean channels 1,600 times per second, maintaining unbroken audio transmission.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.
visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.

scenes.title: RADIO CARRIES DATA • EARBUDS CREATE SOUND
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of RADIO CARRIES DATA • EARBUDS CREATE SOUND.
scenes.narration: यानी फोन से निकली आवाज़ हवा में नहीं उड़ती—रेडियो वेव्ज़ डा-टा ले जाती हैं, और इयर-बड्स उसे आवाज़ में बदलते हैं! अगली बार वायरलेस म्यूज़िक सुनें, तो अपने दोस्तों के साथ शेयर करें कि…

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
visual.action: Complete end-to-end 3D ecosystem showing the full pipeline: Smartphone -> 2.4 GHz Radio Waves -> Earbud Receiver -> Acoustic Sound Waves. Floating takeaway banner lights up: RADIO CARRIES DATA. EARBUDS CREATE SOUND. Smooth camera orbit transitions back into the opening frame for infinite replay.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.

visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.
